goal: Every retained retail T6 MP and Zombies world can be exported deterministically without guessed geometry or silent asset substitution, with renderer-critical T6 semantics either reproduced exactly or preserved in an executable T6-aware scene contract.

statusVocabulary.closed: Required implementation and stated retail proof boundary are satisfied.
statusVocabulary.implemented-awaiting-retail: Production-safe implementation exists; the named retail/corpus execution proof is still pending.
statusVocabulary.partial: Substantial exact implementation/proof exists, but a named semantic or validation gap remains.
statusVocabulary.open: No defensible implementation path exists yet. V2 intentionally has no gates in this state.

gates.title: Lossless retail container preservation and extraction
gates.closureRequirement: All discovered FF/IPAK/SABS/SABL/IWD inputs are preserved byte-for-byte with hashes while normalized extraction is independently audited.

gates.title: GfxWorld primary geometry/index stream
gates.closureRequirement: 36-byte vd0 layout, index reconstruction, surface/group allocation, coordinate conversion and exact range validation are retail-proven.

gates.title: All nine T6 world vertex formats

current.format4: 40 direct material-bound retail vd1 allocations across mp_raid + mp_hijacked; 40/40 stride 12; zero contradictions
current.format5: 13 direct material-bound retail vd1 allocations across mp_raid + mp_hijacked; 13/13 stride 16; zero contradictions
current.format7: 11 direct material-bound retail vd1 allocations across zm_prison + zm_tomb; 11/11 stride 16; zero contradictions
current.format8RetainedCorpus: 0 strict inline MaterialTechniqueSet format-8 bodies across 1,332 strong TechniqueSet bodies in 18 exact retained XFiles; none of the five decoded retained worlds uses format 8 in a surface-referenced vertex group
current.format8TargetGap: 28 of 31 hash-pinned MP map FastFiles remain in the exact format-8 scan queue; unretained Zombies target coverage also remains outside the retained-corpus absence proof

gates.closureRequirement: Registry reports allFormatsExportEnabled=true from clean direct/raw retail evidence with zero contradictory strides for formats 0-8. Format 8 may close from a clean direct/material-bound or standalone raw stride-20 fixture, or from an exhaustive absence proof over the complete hash-pinned target corpus; retained-corpus absence alone is insufficient.

gates.title: Static XModel geometry, LODs, skeleton metadata and placements
gates.closureRequirement: Retail model geometry/LOD/placement transforms reconstruct without guessed axes or oversized-accessor artifacts.

gates.title: Rigid and 1/2/3/4-influence skinned XModels
gates.closureRequirement: Native vertsBlend influence buckets, normalized weights, joint indices, hierarchy and inverse bind matrices validate on retail blended meshes.

gates.title: XAnimParts binary tracks and delta payload decoding/interchange

current.constantFullQuatRetainedCorpusAbsence: exhaustive across all 11,205 XAnimParts in the 18 count-closed retained XFiles
current.knownFixtureGap: no direct constant full-quat delta retail fixture; the size==0 12-byte source branch remains struct-derived outside the currently retained 18-XFile absence proof

gates.closureRequirement: Every serialized delta union branch used across the full target retail corpus must have a retained direct fixture or an exhaustive target-corpus absence proof, with deterministic normalized/compiled round-trip validation. Non-empty compiled-v19 interchange is implemented; remaining closure work is expansion of the exact branch census to the full target corpus or discovery of a direct constant full-quat fixture.

gates.title: XAnim runtime transform composition

current.nonRootTranslation: closed; XModel bind-local translation + XAnim translation delta
current.ordinaryAnimatedRootBoneTranslation: closed; raw decoded XAnim translation, no compact XModel.trans add
current.rootWithModelParent: closed; parent DObj transform composition remains separate from compact XModel.trans
current.deltaDynamicEndpointPolicy: stored native 0..numframes domain only; no fabricated keys

gates.closureRequirement: Direct retail-byte proof covers ordinary root/non-root composition and deltaPart evaluation/application, while production exporter regressions preserve those separate paths without synthetic animation endpoints.

gates.title: Material/image identity and complete dependency retention
gates.closureRequirement: Exact T6 material/GfxImage identities survive OAT disk mapping, collision checks, staging and GLB dependency embedding without semantic substitution.

gates.title: Exact T6 material GPU render-state archival
gates.closureRequirement: Every material used across the hash-pinned retail corpus completes v8 stateBits/stateBitsEntry/constant/sortKey archival with zero routing or enum failures.

current.remainingCorpusGap: 28 hash-pinned MP maps plus unretained Zombies/subzones and non-world/component material scope remain outside the five-world execution proof

gates.title: T6-aware render-state playback
gates.closureRequirement: A T6-aware renderer consumes the exact state routing/descriptors and representative/full-corpus renders validate alpha-test, separate blend equations, cull, depth/write masks, polygon offset and stencil behavior.

gates.title: Layered and special world material shader semantics
gates.closureRequirement: Layered blend/compositor behavior plus special glass/decal/emissive/scrolling/water-like technique families used by target maps are shader/provenance closed and reproduced by the T6-aware adapter.

current.layeredStateOnlyTransformation: slots 2/34: srcBlendRgb SRCALPHA(5) -> ONE(2); all other 60 state bits unchanged
current.remainingSemanticGap: pixel-shader layered weighting/compositor arithmetic and exact playback for the 31 special TechniqueSet families; full target corpus remains pending

gates.title: Lightmap ownership, nullable roles, UV binding and lossless payload archival
gates.closureRequirement: Primary/secondary role presence is preserved exactly, surface/lightmap indices and UVs are retained, and real DDS dependencies are archived without fake fallbacks.

gates.title: Exact T6 lightmap channel meaning and combine equation
gates.closureRequirement: Representative retail T6 world pixel shaders are retained and processed through the implemented pipeline; primary/secondary channel arithmetic is proven across required technique families and the renderer implements only observed equations.

gates.title: Reflection probes, fog, LUT/exposure, sky and scene-light reconstruction
evidence: GfxWorld semantic archival of reflection/fog/exposure/LUT/sky metadata
gates.closureRequirement: Archived environment/light data is consumed by the exported Blender/wgpu scene with representative retail visual validation.

gates.title: Collision, MapEnts/AddOnMapEnts and GameWorld semantics
gates.closureRequirement: All map collision/brush/submodel/trigger/dynamic-entity/path data required for a faithful usable map is normalized or executable from retained authoritative metadata, not merely preserved.

gates.title: FX, animated/dynamic map objects and destructibles
gates.closureRequirement: All target-map dynamic/animated/destructible/FX placements resolve to usable assets and timing/attachment semantics rather than static placeholders.

gates.title: All 31 hash-pinned retail MP maps
gates.closureRequirement: Every hash-pinned MP target completes production export and validation with zero unresolved geometry/material/state/lightmap blockers.

gates.title: All retail Zombies worlds/subzones/patch layers
gates.closureRequirement: A hash-pinned Zombies target manifest exists and every world/subzone/required patch layer completes the same production export/validation contract as MP.

gates.title: Determinism and independent consumer validation
evidence: deterministic GLB hashes on retained fixtures
gates.closureRequirement: The whole target corpus reproduces deterministic hashes/manifests where source inputs match and independently loads in glTF tooling/Blender with validated bounds, indices, skins, materials, animation and scene transforms.

summary.milestone: World formats 0-7 and XAnim runtime composition remain retail-byte closed for their stated scopes. Exact Material render-state archival now executes cleanly across all five decoded retained worlds (1,802 materials / 8,751 states / 48,750 active routes). Layered provenance and world-format selection are exact for 1,130/1,130 retained layered materials, and 31,514 direct T6 layered-state routes reduce to 31,500 layer-0-identical routes plus 14 identical SRCALPHA->ONE transformations. The remaining retained special shader tail is exactly 98 uses across 31 TechniqueSets. Formal closure still requires format 8/full target corpus plus shader/compositor, environment, dynamic-world and independent validation work.

releaseRule: 100% is a boolean certification, not a rounded estimate: every gate above must be status=closed and its closureRequirement must be backed by retained evidence.
